response.narration:
You press the thought of limitless endurance against your body, and your body answers as it always has: with aching ribs, wet boots, and a pulse that still remembers the ford. Nothing in you widens. Vitality is not a thing a soul can be told to hold. It is earned in the living, and the bridge stone under your palm stays cold and indifferent.

Captain Orrel glances over from the parapet, brow raised at whatever look crossed your face. The grey river keeps hurrying beneath you, and the road north waits past the far end of the bridge.
